unitTitle: B2 · Housing and city life: compare competing needs
title: Words: core topic language — set 3
subtitle: B2 · Unit 4: B2 · Housing and city life: compare competing needs

steps.exampleFr: La cohabitation entre cyclistes et piétons exige des règles claires.
steps.exampleEn: Coexistence between cyclists and pedestrians requires clear rules.

steps.exampleFr: L'aménagement urbain tient compte des déplacements quotidiens.
steps.exampleEn: The urban layout accounts for daily travel.

steps.exampleFr: La zone piétonne réduit la circulation devant l'école.
steps.exampleEn: The pedestrian zone reduces traffic in front of the school.

steps.exampleFr: La densification peut rapprocher les services des résidents.
steps.exampleEn: Densification can bring services closer to residents.

steps.exampleFr: Le projet préserverait un espace vert au centre du quartier.
steps.exampleEn: The project would preserve a green space in the centre of the neighbourhood.

steps.exampleFr: Un réseau de transport fiable facilite les déplacements.
steps.exampleEn: A reliable transportation network makes travel easier.

steps.explain: la cohabitation means coexistence; shared use.
un aménagement urbain means an urban development; layout.
une zone piétonne means a pedestrian zone.
un espace vert means a green space.
un réseau de transport means a transportation network.
